1.text: Namwe yarabazuye, mwebwe abari bapfuye muzize ibicumuro n'ibyaha byanyu,

2.text: ibyo mwagenderagamo kera mukurikiza imigenzo y'iyi si, mugakurikiza umwami utegeka ikirere, ari we mwuka ukorera mu batumvira.

3.text: Kandi natwe twese twahoze muri bo dukurikiza ibyo kamere yacu yifuza, tugakora ibyo kamere n'imitima byacu byishakira, kandi ku bwa kavukire yacu twari abo kugirirwa umujinya nk'abandi bose.

4.text: Ariko Imana kuko ari umutunzi w'imbabazi, yaduhinduranye bazima na Kristo

5.text: ku bw'urukundo rwinshi yadukunze, ubwo twari dupfuye tuzize ibicumuro byacu (ubuntu ni bwo bwabakijije),

6.text: nuko ituzurana na we, itwicaranya na we mu ijuru mu buryo bw'umwuka turi muri Kristo Yesu,

7.text: kugira ngo mu bihe bizaza izerekane ubutunzi bw'ubuntu bwayo buhebuje byose, itugirira neza muri Kristo Yesu.

8.text: Mwakijijwe n'ubuntu ku bwo kwizera, ntibyavuye kuri mwe ahubwo ni impano y'Imana.

9.text: Ntibyavuye no ku mirimo kugira ngo hatagira umuntu wirarira,

10.text: kuko turi abo yaremye ituremeye imirimo myiza muri Kristo Yesu, iyo Imana yiteguriye kera kugira ngo tuyigenderemo.

11.text: Nuko mwibuke yuko kera mwebwe abanyamahanga ku mubiri, abo abakebwe n'intoki ku mubiri bita abatakebwe,

12.text: mwibuke ko icyo gihe mwari mudafite Kristo mutandukanijwe n'Ubwisirayeli, muri abashyitsi ku masezerano y'ibyasezeranijwe, ari nta byiringiro mufite by'ibizaba, ahubwo mwari mu isi mudafite Imana Rurema.

13.text: Ariko none kuko muri muri Kristo Yesu, mwebwe abāri kure kera, mwigijwe hafi n'amaraso ya Kristo.

14.text: Uwo ni we mahoro yacu, kuko yahinduye twebwe ababiri kuba umwe akuyeho ubwanzi, ari bwo rusika rwari hagati yacu rutugabanya,

15.text: amaze gukuzaho amategeko y'iby'imihango umubiri we, kugira ngo ba babiri abarememo umuntu umwe mushya muri we ngo azane amahoro atyo,

16.text: kandi ngo bombi abagire umubiri umwe, abungishe n'Imana umusaraba awicishije bwa bwanzi.

17.text: Yaraje ababwira ubutumwa bwiza bw'amahoro mwebwe abāri kure, kandi abāri bugufi na bo ababwira iby'amahoro,

18.text: kuko ari we uduhesha uko turi amaharakubiri, kwegera Data wa twese turi mu Mwuka umwe.

19.text: Nuko ntimukiri abashyitsi n'abasuhuke, ahubwo muri ubwoko bumwe n'abera ndetse muri abo mu nzu y'Imana,

20.text: kuko mwubatswe ku rufatiro rw'intumwa n'abahanuzi, ariko Kristo Yesu ni we buye rikomeza imfuruka.

21.text: Muri we inzu yose iteranijwe neza, irakura ngo ibe urusengero rwera mu Mwami Yesu.

22.text: Muri we namwe murubakanwa, kugira ngo mube inzu yo kubabwamo n'Imana mu Mwuka.
